Messages.Author: Roulon Thibaut
Messages.Body:
Hello!

I have a question concerning Spiridonas (tremere). He may burn X+2
blood to get +X bleed.
If he announces a +6 bleed and is blocked, Does he burn 8 blood
or not ?

Thank you for answers.

Thibaut.

Messages.Author: Nathan Harada
Messages.Body:
> Roulon Thibaut wrote:
>
> Hello!
>
> I have a question concerning Spiridonas (tremere). He may burn X+2
> blood to get +X bleed.
> If he announces a +6 bleed and is blocked, Does he burn 8 blood
> or not ?

Roulon, Spiridonas may burn the blood at any time. He does _not_
have to announce that he will burn blood until he gets through. He
could,
but he doesn't have to burn any blood unless the action is successful.
Most players would declare the bleed with Spiridonas, then wait
until the block was declared unsuccessful or the bleed unblocked. Then
they would burn as much blood as necessary. Although Spiridonas would
be
fairer if he has to declare his bleed when the action begins, as card
text
he can wait.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Roulon Thibaut <roul...@cti.ecp.fr> writes:
> I have a question concerning Spiridonas (tremere). He may burn X+2
>blood to get +X bleed.
> If he announces a +6 bleed and is blocked, Does he burn 8 blood
>or not ?

Yes. His ability is treated as an action modifier (official ruling).

This means that you should only declare that he is bleeding and wait to
see if you are blocked. If not, then burn the blood for the +6 bleed.
